title: POST /v1/systemone response
description: As Brain answers (brain src/deskmind_brain/serve.py, types.py, router.py). v1 requires id, model, usage and latency_ms and adds scored:false (deskmind#36 item 2). Error bodies are in the spec, not here.

answers.description: One answer per question in the request, including questions a two-stage server did not score: those come back uniform, confidence 0, and (v1) scored:false.

input_tokens.description: Tokens of json(state)+json(questions), not of the rendered prompt.

cached.description: Present on a cache hit; latency_ms and routing are the original reply's.

unscored.description: v1: present, false, on a question the server did not score (two-stage); its probabilities are a uniform placeholder, not an answer.

probabilities.description: Every offered option and no other key; 0..1, summing to 1 (±1e-6). tools/check.py checks the parts a schema cannot.

choice.description: The argmax of probabilities; a tie goes to the first option in the request's order.

confidence.description: (K * p_max - 1) / (K - 1); 1.0 when K <= 1. Clients read probabilities.

confirmed.description: Both tiers chose the same terminal operation (DONE, BLOCKED or ASK).
